description: This file contains CPU-specific implementations for the flex attention mechanism in PyTorch's _inductor backend, including functions for checking CPU support and lowering the operation to a CPU template.

classes.name: CppFlexAttentionTemplate
classes.description: Template class for CPU flex attention implementation, with methods to add choices for kernel autotuning.

methods.name: check_cpu_supported()
methods.description: Checks if the current CPU supports AVX2 and if certain environment conditions are met.

methods.name: lower_cpu( query, key, value, subgraph, block_mask, scale, kernel_options, score_mod_other_buffers, mask_mod_other_buffers, )
methods.description: Lowers the high-level flex attention operation into CPU-specific kernels, including preparation of buffers, shape management, and graph transformations.
